declarations.description:
Two-segment ratio bar comparing two quantities, such as the bid/ask balance of an order book or the yes/no split of
a vote. `start-value` and `end-value` are raw amounts in any unit; the bar splits its width between them in
proportion and, with `show-value`, prints each side's share as a percentage at its end. The two percentages always
add up to 100. `start-label` and `end-label` name the sides for assistive technology, which reads the whole bar as
one image ("Bid 22.43%, Ask 77.57%"). Override either printed share through the `start` and `end` slots.
declarations.name: ComparisonBar

cssProperties.description: Width of the whole component; the host is a block by default.
cssProperties.name: --c2-comparison-bar--width

cssProperties.description: Space between the percentages and the track.
cssProperties.name: --c2-comparison-bar--gap

cssProperties.description: How long a segment takes to resize when a value changes.
cssProperties.name: --c2-comparison-bar--transition-duration

cssParts.description: Text region at the start edge containing the custom `start` slot or the start percentage fallback.
cssParts.name: start-value

cssParts.description: Text region at the end edge containing the custom `end` slot or the end percentage fallback.
cssParts.name: end-value

slots.description: Replaces the start side's percentage text (e.g. "Buy 22%").
slots.name: start

slots.description: Replaces the end side's percentage text.
slots.name: end

members.name: startValue
members.description: Amount on the start side (bids, buyers, "yes" votes). Negative values count as `0`.

members.name: endValue
members.description: Amount on the end side (asks, sellers, "no" votes). Negative values count as `0`.

members.name: startLabel
members.description: Name of the start side, announced before its share.

members.name: endLabel
members.description: Name of the end side, announced before its share.

members.name: showValue
members.description: Print each side's percentage at its end of the bar. Always on for a side whose slot has content.

members.name: precision
members.description: Fraction digits of the printed and announced percentages.

members.name: locale
members.description: BCP 47 locale used to format the percentages; the document's locale when unset.

members.name: startPercent
members.description: Share of the start side, `0` to `100`. Both sides get `50` while neither has an amount.

members.name: endPercent
members.description: Share of the end side; always `100 - startPercent`, so the printed shares add up.
